narration.text: This is Ravi. Every morning he helps his Ajji in their chilli nursery near Haveri.
In fourteen days, the seedlings go to the Monday shandy. But some of them are turning yellow.
What do you want to find out?
Yes. The plant with both sunlight and water grew tall and green.
Look again. Without water, the plant in the sun dried up.
Many people think water is enough. But in the dark, this plant grew thin and pale.
After two weeks, the plant with sunlight and water grew best.
Plants require both sunlight and water for their growth.
Under the stone there was no light. So the grass could not grow green.
Not quite. Without light, the seedlings cannot grow green.
Right. A week without light turns them pale and yellow.
Look at the grass under the stone. Without light, plants change.
Did you know? An old Indian text called Vrikshayurveda recorded how to care for plants, soil and crops.
These seedlings have sunlight and water. So why are they still weak? Next time, we find out.
Well done. You found out what plants need to grow.
